assumptions: The sample is the molecule as written: no counter-ions, modifications or water are weighed.
limits: The weight is the free acid. A table using an average 660 g/mol per base pair (Promega's BioMath does) gives several percent fewer moles.
Purity and concentration error are not modelled.
bio.jane/contract.question: How many picomoles, or how many copies, is this much of this molecule?

description: Convert a mass of a molecule to an amount in moles and a number of molecules, or an amount back to a mass. The weight is the open record's own, computed from its sequence (both strands of a double-stranded record under its topology, a protein from its residues), or one you give.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

amount.description: the amount in moles to convert. Leave it or `mass` empty.

amount_unit.description: the unit of the amount, given or solved.

mass.description: the mass to convert. Leave it or `amount` empty: the empty one is calculated.

mass_unit.description: the unit of the mass, given or solved.

molecular_weight.description: g/mol. Leave empty to weigh the open record from its sequence; give it for a molecule that is not open. In g/mol. Advanced.

strands.description: which strands of the open record to weigh. From the record weighs both strands of DNA and the one strand of an RNA (U and no T); choose one strand for an oligo. Values: record (From the record), double (Both strands), single (One strand). Only applies when molecular_weight is not given.

name: convert_mass_moles

amount.description: the amount in moles, in its unit
